Privacy policy

Translation for information only. The Czech version is legally binding.

The data controller is Dajpr s.r.o., company ID 05753040, Nové Syrovice 141, 675 41 Nové Syrovice, e-mail info@panelcz.cz.

What data we process

  • Name, address, phone, e-mail and booking details: to perform the accommodation contract.
  • ID document details: legally required guest registration and tourist tax.
  • Billing details: accounting and tax obligations (kept for 10 years).
  • Camera recordings of outdoor areas: legitimate interest in protecting property and safety. Recordings are kept for at most 14 days and only reviewed if a problem occurs.
  • Website cookies and analytics data: only with your consent.

Who we share data with

The operator of the Previo booking system, our accountants and our web host, always only to the extent necessary. The website uses Google Analytics, Facebook and the Previo booking system, which may process data outside the EU too.

Your rights

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability and objection. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz).
